notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 2 were picked from the cb_bbkc_es_v2_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, overlap with each other) as well as 2018–2022, and the grid itself was chosen after reading round 1 on 2023–2024, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategies held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First squeeze-breakout look at the ES holdout. #12 and #50 were frozen as a pair before any 2025+ bar was loaded (runs/funnel/cb_bbkc_es_v2_15m/holdout_selection_12_50.json). The ledger shows 3 earlier holdout loads, but all three were the same day's scoring of these same two strategies (final-test, then a combined-account and random-entry check); nothing was picked or changed after seeing them. The mean-reversion and noise-band families were scored on ES 2025+ earlier (different strategies), so the researcher has seen how that period treated them. The 15m config's research_history entry for the 5m sibling was edited after freezing (bookkeeping only; no gate, threshold, data window or cost changed).
